digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, model ladder and context-window sizing
propositions: models_at_or_above returns the entire ladder for a non-Anthropic-family primary instead of the primary itself, causing escalation to downgrade to a smaller model in a different provider family.

largest_window_tokens returns the ladder maximum for an unlocated primary instead of a conservative minimum, causing P8 to under-block and review to truncate material instead of reporting decomposition required.
prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-261 jumps from the operator's model to claude-haiku-4-5 when the primary is not in the ladder, matching the defect in models_at_or_above.

For a non-Anthropic-family primary that context-limits at every attempt, the escalation loop never attempts the single-criterion retry because it starts from the wrong rung, losing the most common recovery path.
